description: This PHP class 'WorkShiftDecorator' provides a decorator pattern implementation for the 'WorkShift' entity, enabling formatted access to its start and end times using helper traits for date/time formatting.

classes.name: WorkShiftDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the WorkShift entity, providing formatted start and end time strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a WorkShift object.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the shift formatted as a string, or null if not available.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the shift formatted as a string, or null if not available.
